title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer thresholds to prevent overload during regional failover
author: Priya Patel
description:
Motivation: During the 2026-02-25 regional failover event we observed cascade overloads in eu-west when traffic shifted to remaining regions. The SLO enforcer aggressively started load-shedding without progressive backoff, which led to oscillation and client timeouts. This hotfix tightens enforcement thresholds, adds exponential backoff for shedding decisions, and introduces per-region capacity multipliers to avoid over-reacting during failover.

Summary of changes: - Reduce aggressive shedding threshold from 85% to 92% of observed CPU/throughput for short spikes; rely on longer-window violation rate for sustained shedding. - Add exponential backoff and jitter to shedding decisions so repeated triggers relax before re-evaluating. - Introduce per-region capacity_multiplier config to account for known cold spare capacity during failovers. - Add immediate-fallback route that prefers smaller "degraded" model variants during overload (no quality regression beyond degraded tier). - Increase default readinessProbe and CPU request for slo-enforcer deployment to avoid OOM/restarts under transient pressure. - Add integration test that simulates regional failover and asserts no operator-level oscillation. - Update alert thresholds so on-call gets early headroom warnings before shedding.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for backoff logic (tests/slo/backoff_test.go) - [x] Integration test for regional failover (tests/slo/failover_integration_test.go) - [x] Manual canary in staging during 2026-03-01 window - [x] Docs/ops playbook updated with rollback steps and mitigation (docs/ops/regional-failover.md) - [x] Security scan run (no new issues)

Impact: This is a targeted hotfix; behavior change is limited to the SLO enforcer during high-load/regional-failover scenarios. Default behavior unchanged for normal operations. Ops: roll out to staging first, then greenfield regions, then a canary in prod with automatic rollback if error rate escalates. Linear/Jira: ENG-7834, SRE-212, SUP-1123.
